notes.title: Project Ictos Version 1.4.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Menus now have a slight navigation delay when first entering them (only navigation, not usage)
 The death screen's navigation delay is slightly longer so you don't accidentally interact with the main menu button

notes.title: Project Ictos Version 1.4 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Fixed upscaling shader for the game objects.
 Made the death screen a bit faster
 Made retrying a bit faster
 Added a loading indicator when retrying

notes.title: Project Ictos Version 1.3 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Tweaked level 33 and 54
 Fixed pixel resolution on camera being two pixels too small
 Made the infinite mode flipped chance a lower percentage (80% -> 50%)

notes.title: Project Ictos Version 1.2 Patch Notes
notes.notes: Fixes an issue when the system time format was set to the Japanese format, and it caused the game to enter an infinite loop... for some reason.

notes.title: Project Ictos Version 1.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
A short delay when dying so you don't accidentally select the main menu option
 Levels are sorted in difficulty groups and randomly picked from those groups for Normal and Flipped Mode
 Properly reset level stats for the Discord Integration
